name: trademe_nz-automotive-mcp
description: Trade Me Motors (automotive): search_listings, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

platform_mcp_trademe_nz_consumer_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_NZ_CONSUMER_KEY
platform_mcp_trademe_nz_consumer_key.description: Trade Me API consumer key of your registered application (My Trade Me → Developer options; API access is granted after Trade Me reviews the application).

platform_mcp_trademe_nz_consumer_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_NZ_CONSUMER_SECRET
platform_mcp_trademe_nz_consumer_secret.description: The application's consumer secret: sent as the OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT signature '<consumer secret>&' over HTTPS (Trade Me's documented PLAINTEXT workflow).

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: GET /v1/Search/Motors/Used.json ('filtered keyword search in the Used cars section of Trade Me Motors') with the application-level OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT header; rows ≤ 25 without a member token. make is a Trade Me Used-cars subcategory name (e.g. Toyota), model a model name; condition New|Used; location is not a search filter here (user_region takes a numeric motors region id, not mapped). price is StartPrice (NZD; for classifieds the asking price, see raw.PriceDisplay and raw.BuyNowPrice); StartDate uses Trade Me's '/Date(ms)/' format. Listing page: https://www.trademe.co.nz/a/<ListingId>.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET /v1/Listings/<ListingId>.json (ListedItemDetail): title, StartPrice/BuyNowPrice/PriceDisplay, Region, Body, Attributes (make, model, year, odometer … as name/value pairs) and Photos stay in raw.
